# SYMBOLS.md — exported-symbol parity

Generated by `tools/gen_symbols.py`; every number below comes from `nm -D`.

```
nm -D --defined-only c_src/build/libpng.so       # reference C build
nm -D --defined-only target/release/liblibpng.so # translated Rust cdylib
```

## Summary

| | count |
|---|---|
| symbols exported by the C `.so` | 384 |
| symbols exported by the Rust `.so` | 384 |
| **exported by C but MISSING from Rust** | **0** |
| exported by Rust but not by C (extra) | 0 |
| symbols whose `nm` type letter differs | 0 |
| non-libc / non-zlib undefined symbols in the Rust `.so` | 0 |

The Rust `.so` exports exactly the same 384 symbols as the C `.so`, with the same
`nm` type letters (`T` = text/function, `R` = read-only data).  Nothing is
stubbed: `tests/sweep.rs` calls **all 381 exported functions** through `dlsym` and
compares the result against the C library, and the three exported data tables
(`png_sRGB_table`, `png_sRGB_base`, `png_sRGB_delta`) are compared element by
element in `tests/smoke.rs::pure_functions_agree`.

## Feature combinations

`Cargo.toml` declares **no `[features]` section**, so the power set of the
crate's features is the single empty combination.  `tools/check_features.sh`
derives that list mechanically from `Cargo.toml` (rather than assuming it) and
runs `cargo check`, `cargo build --release` and the whole differential suite for
each element:

| # | combination | commands run |
|---|-------------|--------------|
| 1 | *(empty — the only one)* | `cargo check --offline --no-default-features --features ""`, `cargo build --release …`, `./check.sh …` |

`cargo check --all-features` and `cargo check` (default) are the same
configuration here and were run too.

The C side has one configuration as well: `c_src/CMakeLists.txt` globs `src/*.c`
with no options, and the build configuration is the checked-in
`c_src/include/pnglibconf.h` (202 `#define`s — essentially every
`PNG_*_SUPPORTED` is on).  There is no second code path to switch to on either
side.

The reference C `libpng.so` links the very same zlib
(`target_link_libraries(png PRIVATE ZLIB::ZLIB)`), so both libraries call
byte-identical DEFLATE/INFLATE.  (`c_src/CMakeLists.txt` does *not* link libm,
so the C `.so` leaves `floor`/`pow`/`log` undefined and relies on the program to
supply them; the test harness publishes `libm.so.6` with `RTLD_GLOBAL` before
loading it.)
